decisions: Kept the existing candidate-count ambiguity failure unchanged.
Limited the additional eligibility filters to post-commit push context resolution.
functional_changes: Develop push context ignores completed read-only tasks and resolves the committed modifying task uniquely.
intentionally_not_implemented: No new status machine or architecture.
No staging, commit, or push in the working repository.
recommended_next_step: Review the local diff without staging, committing, or pushing unless separately authorized.
technical_changes: Push candidate selection now requires a completed receipt, commit permission, non-empty changed paths, and an exact start-head match to the current HEAD parent.
Added regression coverage for multiple read-only analyses followed by a modifying task, commit, and push resolution.
